declare
 v_local_time date;
begin
 -- Added by arun on 02/01/2012. SCR 18938
 if is_timezone_enabled 
 then

 else

 end if;
 -- End 
 select test_desc 
 into :test_desc 
 from valid_tests
 where test_id = :test_id and
 --sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365); -- SCR 18938
 v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_time+365);
 begin
 select 'x' 
 into :global.x

exception

RecordGroup.Name: RGT_TEST_MA_TEST_ID_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select test_group, test_id, test_desc
 from valid_tests
 where Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:ctrl_block_1.chapter_id,
 sysdate) between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date, sysdate + 365)
 and test_id not in
 (select test_id
 from rgt_test_matrix
 where contract_id = :ctrl_block_1.contract_id)
 and test_id in
 (select test_id
 from contract_tests_image
 where contract_id = :ctrl_block_1.contract_id
 and term_date is null
 or term_date >
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:ctrl_block_1.chapter_id,
 sysdate))
 order by test_desc

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLOCK__CONTRACT_ID_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select contract_id,company 
from contracts 
where ((upper(company) like upper('%'||:ctrl_block_1.contract_id||'%')) or 
 (upper(contract_id) like upper('%'||:ctrl_block_1.contract_id||'%'))) 
and contract_type = 'RG' 
and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:ctrl_block_1.chapter_id, sysdate) between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10) 
order by contract_id
